rights.warning: ROSE & Bruno Mars 'APT.' is a commercial major-label recording. Muxing it into an MP4 and uploading via API is an unlicensed sync use. Do not enable without a human rights decision. See the risk note in hermes/src/music.ts.
rights.enforced_in_code: hermes/src/music.ts aptRightsCleared() reads THIS FIELD and render.ts aptAppliesTo() refuses the bed unless cleared === true. Setting HERMES_MUSIC_APT=1 is no longer sufficient on its own; clearing this bed means editing this rights record.

incident.what_happened: Four of six Hermes-generated YouTube Shorts published on 2026-08-04 were hard-blocked with zero views. Cross-correlation of the published CDN media against these segments and the licensed beds scored the APT segments at 0.33-0.47 at lag ~0.04s versus 0.013-0.015 for every licensed bed, a ~25x ratio: the uncleared track was in the shipped files. The three posts on the channel that played normally that day (the riddle film, the Roblox announcement, a rebus) are the only ones that do not carry it.
incident.how_it_got_enabled: The feature and this manifest, including rights.cleared=false and the do-not-enable warning, landed together in e41d270 on 2026-07-28. HERMES_MUSIC_APT=1 was set in /etc/hermes/hermes.env the same evening: the backup taken immediately before it, hermes.env.bak.pre-apt-20260728T194336Z (19:43:36 UTC), carries no such line and the next backup does. The following day 08b861a added MUSIC_APT_YOUTUBE defaulting ON, so the bed reached YouTube - the platform the same commit identified as having the categorically worse downside, because a Content ID claim on a Short over one minute is a hard block rather than a monetisation redirect, and these run 69-91s. Every one of those commits is authored 'Hermes VPS', the box's own agent identity. No human rights decision is recorded anywhere.
incident.resolution: 2026-08-04: HERMES_MUSIC_APT=0 and HERMES_MUSIC_APT_YOUTUBE=0 in /etc/hermes/hermes.env (backup hermes.env.bak-20260804T233719Z), plus the code gate above so the env flag is not the only thing standing between the pipeline and a claim. The five already-blocked posts are not recoverable.
incident.not_explained_by_this: TikTok. Its median fell from roughly 300 views per post to 1-4 starting 2026-07-24, FIVE DAYS BEFORE this bed was enabled, so the music cannot be its cause and a recovery on YouTube must not be read as having fixed TikTok.
